content:
arpit: Opening a tiny decision thread on API key scope semantics. We need a terse rule set for the RFC follow-up.

lina: Problem we've seen: org keys sometimes implicitly grant project access. That created a confusing audit trail for a partner integration.

maria: Proposal: make implicit inheritance opt-in and explicit. New boolean `inherit_scope` on keys controls whether an org key can be used against projects in the same org. Default = false (no inheritance).

toshi: Nice name. Two followups: (1) what privilege mapping happens when inheritance is used? (2) how do gateways cache decisions?

arpit: For mapping: when a key with `inherit_scope=true` is used in project P, resolve permissions against the key's origin (org-level grants). Do NOT apply project-only grants unless there's an explicit mapping rule. That avoids privilege inflation.

lina: Implementation note: add an optional `role_map` on keys that allows mapping org-roles -> project-roles for specific cases. Must be admin-only and require justification string.

maria: Cache design: cache the tuple (key_id, target_project, resolved_mode) for a short TTL (20s). On key metadata changes publish to `key-events` topic so gateways can evict immediately. If the event system is down, fallback behavior = strict deny to avoid accidental access.

toshi: Revocation: delegated or inherited access must support immediate revoke. Gateways check a revocation list with a short negative-cache; document expected propagation delays.

arpit: Auditing: every resolved auth decision must log: key_id, origin_scope, target_project, branch_taken (direct, inherit, mapped), actor, and justification if present. Make this queryable via API.

lina: UX: console add a column "Scope inheritance" and a per-key timeline showing last 10 distinct target projects. Also a one-click "Split to project keys" action that scaffolds separate project keys.

maria: Migration plan: provide `rbt keys --scan-inheritance-candidates` that lists org keys with cross-project traffic, suggested project splits, and an estimated impact preview (dry-run).

toshi: Metric needs: attempted_inherit_count, successful_inherit_count, top-inheriting-keys, and billing_attrib_delta after migration.

arpit: Third-party integrations: allow org-admins to enable an org-level compatibility toggle which temporarily allows inheritance for all keys in the org. This must be timeboxed and emit a banner/email to admins.

lina: Security nuance: token kinds. Introduce `token_kind` enum {user, service, system}. Only `service` and `system` tokens may set `inherit_scope` (and only by admin).

maria: Edge-case: CI jobs that create resources in multiple projects. Rather than granting inheritance, prefer delegated short-lived project tokens via POST /keys/:id/delegate. Delegation tokens are limited TTL and whitelist actions.

toshi: Rate-limits: add per-key delegation QPS and per-org delegation budget. Reject with 429 when exceeded. Also log throttled attempts for review.

arpit: Final short recommendation for RFC follow-up: default no inheritance, add admin-only `inherit_scope` + `role_map`, token_kind enforcement, event-driven cache invalidation via `key-events`, strict-deny fallback if event propagation fails, audit fields and console/migration tooling, org compatibility toggle for legacy, delegation primitives for CI, revoke APIs + negative-cache guidance, and telemetry.

auth-bot: [alert] found 4 org keys in "beta-org" with >8 project destinations in last 14d. Recommended review.

lina: Thanks all. I'll include this paragraph in the RFC follow-up and add CLI examples. Ping me if you want wording changes. :thumbsup:
